channel.title: Eject Guard
channel.description: Ejects external disks before a meeting starts.

item.title: Version 1.3.2
item.description:
Fewer stalls while Time Machine backs up. Every snapshot Time Machine mounted during a backup made the app read the disk list again, and the Time Machine tool it asks could hang for half a minute, which could hold up an eject that was due. The app now looks again only when a disk it could guard comes or goes.

Signed with Developer ID, notarized and stapled. Requires macOS 14.
